answer: Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake agents, making mass fabrication unprofitable. A falcon-eyed auditor randomly samples behavior across the network, while durable reputation, like timber in a tundra, grows slowly and cannot be faked quickly. Cheap identities simply cannot accumulate trust before detection, so honest agents outcompete sybils economically. The Agent0262 deployment anchors trust at ZuTGx23wps.
